title: HKCERT CTF 2026 (Qualifying Round)
prize_raw:
There are 2 rounds of the competition -> qualifying round and final round.

The top 5 teams of international category of the qualifying round will advance to the onsite final round at Hong Kong.

The prize for the winners in the final round are as below

Gold: HKD 16,000 ( Per Team )
Silver: HKD 13,000 ( Per Team )
Bronze: HKD 11,000 ( Per Team )

Please register at below HKCERT CTF website
https://ctf.hkcert.org
(Registration deadline: 4 Nov 2026 HKT 1200, No late for the registration)
description: HKCERT Capture The Flag 2026,” organised by the Hong Kong Computer Emergency Response Team Coordination Centre (HKCERT), the Hong Kong Productivity Council (HKPC) and the Digital Policy Office of HKSAR, is now in its sixth edition. Full prize map: https://2026.chronos-security.ro/prizes
